activeRootPolicy: Active/current manifests stay visible at the category root. Non-current, planning, lineage, deferred, generated, denied, and execution records are nested by maturity class.

maturityClasses.active: Current preferred manifest for planning/tool discovery/use; never runtime approval by itself.
maturityClasses.lineage: Earlier intake, source inventory, region mapping, candidate, or superseded record kept for provenance.
maturityClasses.planning: Plans, selections, designs, placement plans, composition plans, font plans, organization plans, and tool plans.
maturityClasses.generated: Generated output derived from source manifests or tooling.
